cues.zh: 我得找个安全的地方停下来。
cues.en: So I'm just gonna have to find somewhere safe to stop.

cues.zh: 到了，那儿有个临时停车带。
cues.en: Here we go, that's a lay-by.
Alright, we're gonna stop here.

cues.zh: 我得先接到那条路线的起点，
cues.en: I'm gonna have to join the start of that route,
and then just try and follow it.
There's no other way to do it.

cues.zh: 反正我骨子里就是个悲观的人。
cues.en: I'm kind of a pessimist by heart anyway.

cues.zh: 我们一到，他就会在Gibson Square，笑眯眯地。
cues.en: We're gonna turn up, he's gonna be in Gibson Square, smiling.
So true.

cues.zh: 看着我说：“你跑哪儿去了？”
cues.en: Looking at me saying, "Where did you get to?"
(laughs)

cues.zh: 那句话会永远刻在我脑子里——“你怎么这么久才到？”
cues.en: And that'll be forever emblazoned— "What took you so long?"

cues.zh: 他肯定会说这种话，对吧？
cues.en: He's gonna say something like that, isn't he?

cues.zh: 这句话会刻在我脑子里，直到我生命的尽头。
cues.en: That's gonna be emblazoned in my brain for the rest of my eternity.

cues.zh: 然后我就再也干不了出租车司机这活儿了。
cues.en: And I will no longer be able to complete my job as a cab driver.

cues.zh: 我还不如直接把工牌交给他。
cues.en: I might as well hand him my badge.

cues.zh: 但我忘了，一直这么干有多费脑子。
cues.en: But I forgot just how mentally tiring it is to constantly do this.

cues.zh: 我真不知道Tom是怎么连续干上好几个小时的。
cues.en: I dunno how Tom does it for hours and hours.

cues.zh: ♪ 开呀，开呀，开呀，你的车，轻轻开在公路上 ♪
cues.en: ♪ Drive, drive, drive your car gently down the road ♪

cues.zh: ♪ 欢快地，欢快地，欢快地……遵守交通规则 ♪
cues.en: ♪ Merrily, merrily, merrily... obey the highway code ♪
Oh my god, it's so close.
Oh.
It's actually so close.
Oh no.
Like it's ridiculously close.
Don't say that.

cues.zh: 我实在受不了这差距有多小。
cues.en: I actually can't cope with how close this is.
Two minutes to go until we're there,

cues.zh: 我猜我知道到了之后会看到什么。
cues.en: and I suspect I know what I'm gonna find when I get there.
Really? Mm...

cues.zh: 我觉得我不可能不说出来。
cues.en: I don't think there's any way I could never say.

cues.zh: 我觉得这局我不可能赢了。
cues.en: I don't think there's any way I've won this one.
It's not a race.

cues.zh: 这不是比赛，但话说回来……这不是比赛。
cues.en: It's not a race, but also... It's not a race.

cues.zh: 我觉得这局我不可能赢了。
cues.en: I don't think there's any way I've won this one.

cues.zh: 我真想看到他“叮”一声，就从我们旁边过去。
cues.en: I really wanna just see him just go ding, like past us here.

cues.zh: 我真的觉得我们可能很快就会看到他。
cues.en: I honestly think we could be seeing him very soon.

cues.zh: 要是他这么干，我就会直接狂按喇叭，然后大喊，
cues.en: If he does, I'm just gonna blare the horn and be like,
"Nooo!"
I think the thing I'm most happy about is that

cues.zh: 我全程都没有做过任何违法操作。
cues.en: at no point have I made any illegal manoeuvres.
Yep.

cues.zh: 我全程都没看错 GPS，也没走错路。
cues.en: At no point have I misread the GPS or gone the wrong way.

cues.zh: 这趟车开得真让人紧张。
cues.en: That was a very stressful drive.
Turn left onto Gibson Square.
Then you will arrive at your destination.

cues.zh: 哦，对，我看到 Gibson Square 了。
cues.en: Oh yeah, I see Gibson Square.
This is it.
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
Where's a TX4?
This is us, right?

cues.zh: 对，我们到了，可我没看到 TX4。
cues.en: Yeah, this is us, but I can't see a TX4.
Right, well pull in then!
Pull in! No way!

cues.zh: 我们赢了吗？我们赢了吗？
cues.en: Have we won? Have we won?
I can't see him.
Oh my goodness.
Oh my word, please.
Oh my god, have we won?
No way. (both squealing)
Where is he?
Tom?!
Is he here?

cues.zh: 我们赢了吗？我觉得赢了。
cues.en: Did we win? I think we did.
Yes!
Yes, beat that, Tom Scott.
Gibson Square.
Aww!
Oh, there we go!
No way!

cues.zh: 我先停好车，待会儿跟你聊。
cues.en: I'll park up and talk to you in a minute.
See you in a sec.

cues.zh: 是啊，我觉得我那儿根本没戏，对吧？
cues.en: Yeah, I don't think I stood a chance there, did I?
Well done though.
How close was it?

cues.zh: 哥们，我们在这儿待了大概20分钟了。
cues.en: We was here for about 20 minutes, mate.

cues.zh: 说实话，我们才刚停好车。
cues.en: Honestly, we've only just pulled up.

cues.zh: 真的吗？我知道大家都说，
cues.en: Really? I know that everyone's like,
"Oh, it's so close!" and stuff like that.
I thought you had won that.

cues.zh: 你觉得没有那个，光靠你已有的知识，能完成吗？
cues.en: Do you think you could have done it without that,
with your knowledge already? Absolutely not. Absolutely not.
Really?
Because you are always around London.

cues.zh: 你了解伦敦，你来过这儿，你在这儿开过车。
cues.en: You know London, you've been here, you've drove here.
I've driven some of these roads.

cues.zh: 但我肯定会碰上两三次堵车。
cues.en: But I would've hit traffic two or three times.
I would've been in the wrong lane.
I would've gone the wrong way. Right.

cues.zh: 最后那半英里的导航可真能把我搞懵。
cues.en: And trying to navigate that last half mile would've got me.

cues.zh: 我觉得，不管是 Google 还是你用的什么导航，
cues.en: I think, yeah, Google or whoever you use,

cues.zh: 不管用什么，在这儿都掉链子了，不过……
cues.en: whatever you use, has let you down there, but...
It's all variables.
Well done, man.
Thank you Tom. It's been a pleasure.
